status: Registered and pushed before any fresh row was read.
question: Does the orientation brief help a Claude host where the evidence brief did not, with tools and on the paste path?
design_inputs: The orientation layout was designed after reading the six exposed host-comparison cases; none of the cases below.

cases.pool: dev rows at offsets 300 to 699 (never read), minus every text_id of the 50-row py test split (reserved, compared by id only), minus every repository used in the 2026-11-07 external run or the 2026-11-08 frozen run
cases.filters: permissive repository license (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3, ISC, MPL-2.0); 50 to 1,500 non-test files; at most 10 changed files; one case per repository
cases.acquisition: shallow git fetch at base_sha, copied without .git; caps 300 MiB per checkout, 2 GiB total; omissions disclosed
cases.gold: changed_files of the fixing pull request

host.prompts: identical to benchmarks/host-comparison-2026-11-08 and paste-comparison-2026-11-08 except the file name of the brief

decision_rules.tools_path: orientation counts as helping with tools only if total hits at 5 are not lower than native AND median host tokens or median tool calls are lower
decision_rules.paste_path: orientation counts as helping on the paste path only if total hits at 5 are higher than issue-only AND it wins more cases than it loses
decision_rules.otherwise: not established; every run is reported

limits: public issues may be in the host's training data
isolation by instruction; tool calls not audited
